market_question: Will Gretchen Whitmer win the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination?
reasoning: Gretchen Whitmer is a prominent swing-state governor frequently mentioned as a top 2028 contender. Even conservative estimates of her running and winning probability (e.g., 40% run × 25% win = 10%) far exceed the market’s 1.1%. No negative signals justify such a low price.
evidence_points: Whitmer is a leading Democratic figure with high national name recognition after her COVID response and kidnapping plot spotlight.
She won re-election in Michigan by 10.5 points in 2022, demonstrating broad appeal.
Multiple early 2028 Democratic nomination polls include her in top tiers, often alongside Harris, Newsom, Pritzker.
Term-limited as governor in 2026, she has a natural timeline to campaign for president.
